## 2. CLI API

### `aiw`

AI Workspace Launcher

**Subcommands:**

- `agy`
- `completion`
- `config`
- `forget`
- `list`

### `aiw agy`

Launch agy in an isolated Fence sandbox for a workspace

| Flag / Argument    | Type             | Required | Default | Description                                       |
| ------------------ | ---------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `--dry-run`        | `-`              | No       | `-`     | Print generated Fence command without executing   |
| `<EXTRA-ARGS>`     | `EXTRA_ARGS`     | Yes      | `-`     | Extra arguments forwarded directly to agy         |
| `<WORKSPACE-NAME>` | `WORKSPACE_NAME` | Yes      | `-`     | Workspace name under .workspaces/<workspace-name> |

### `aiw completion`

Generate shell completion script

| Flag / Argument | Type    | Required | Default | Description                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------- |
| `<SHELL>`       | `SHELL` | Yes      | `-`     | Shell to generate completions for |

### `aiw config`

Manage aiw configuration

**Subcommands:**

- `init`

### `aiw config init`

Initialize fence.jsonc configuration files

| Flag / Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description                            |
| --------------- | ---- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `-f`, `--force` | `-`  | No       | `-`     | Overwrite existing configuration files |

**Subcommands:**

- `project`
- `user`

### `aiw config init project`

Initialize project configuration (fence.jsonc) [default]

| Flag / Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description                            |
| --------------- | ---- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `-f`, `--force` | `-`  | No       | `-`     | Overwrite existing configuration files |

### `aiw config init user`

Initialize user configuration (~/.config/aiw/fence.jsonc)

| Flag / Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description                            |
| --------------- | ---- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `-f`, `--force` | `-`  | No       | `-`     | Overwrite existing configuration files |

### `aiw forget`

Forget a workspace

| Flag / Argument    | Type             | Required | Default | Description                                       |
| ------------------ | ---------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `<WORKSPACE-NAME>` | `WORKSPACE_NAME` | Yes      | `-`     | Workspace name under .workspaces/<workspace-name> |

### `aiw list`

List all available workspaces
